tasks.title: Prove independent branch progress during HUMAN_WAIT
tasks.prompt: Add an offline Phase 9 DAG probe proving one branch can enter HUMAN_WAIT while an independent branch remains runnable and completes; descendants of the waiting branch remain blocked; after explicit resolution and completion the dependent node becomes runnable. No network calls or dependencies.

tasks.title: Integrate DAG selection into trusted controller behind fallback
tasks.prompt: Integrate the proven TaskGraph scheduler into the trusted controller without removing the existing FIFO queue fallback. The trusted path must never dispatch a task with incomplete dependencies and must keep HUMAN_WAIT branches isolated. Add security and regression tests before enabling any DAG-backed dispatch.

tasks.title: Prove trusted DAG dispatch path end to end
tasks.prompt: Add a deterministic trusted-controller probe proving DAG-backed selection dispatches an independent runnable task while another branch is HUMAN_WAIT, preserves FIFO fallback compatibility, and never dispatches blocked descendants. Keep the proof offline.
